$comment: SSOT for UI/API port assignments and stack pairings. Used by dev-start.sh.

strategy.$note: Strategy UI fetches /api/strategies/* from execution-results-api. Backtest runs use a separate local Python process (port 5001), not an API service.

settlement.$note: Settlement routes live in trading-analytics-api (/settlement/* and /settlements/*). No separate settlement-api needed.

live-health-monitor.$note: Live health monitor calls /api/positions, /api/risk, /api/health from execution-results-api. Manual trade instructions route to execution-service directly (VITE_EXECUTION_API_URL).

logs-dashboard.$note: Logs dashboard calls /api/v1/audit/trail and /audit/trail/services from batch-audit-api. Manifest confirms batch-audit-api serves_ui includes logs-dashboard-ui.

odum-website.$note: Self-contained Next.js app with built-in API routes (Firebase Auth + Firestore). No separate API service. Uses port 3000 (Next.js default) instead of 5184 to match Next.js convention.

user-management.$note: Admin UI for user lifecycle management (onboard/modify/offboard). OAuth admin auth. Mock mode uses client-side fetch intercepts. Backend API TBD — currently calls external APIs (GitHub, Slack, MS Graph, GCP) via mock layer.

unified-trading.$note: Consolidated API gateway replacing 9 separate domain data APIs. 61 endpoints across 16 domains. WebSocket at /ws. Will eventually replace execution-analytics, trading-analytics, batch-audit, ml-training, ml-inference, client-reporting, market-data, config stacks.

service_workers.$comment: Backend services that are NOT part of a UI/API stack but required for SIT and local integration tests. extra_args are appended to 'python -m <module>' by dev-start.sh.

execution-service.$note: FIX engine. Port 8005 is taken by config-api (onboarding stack), so uses 8018. Runs live execution mode in dev.

risk-and-exposure-service.$note: Reads mode from MODE env var (set to 'live' by dev-start.sh via DEV_RUNTIME_MODE mapping). No CLI args needed.

position-balance-monitor-service.$note: CLI requires --operation and --mode. --skip-startup-recon avoids exchange API calls in dev.

alerting-service.$note: Uses __main__.py entry point (python -m alerting_service). CLI requires --mode.

pnl-attribution-service.$note: Uses __main__.py entry point (python -m pnl_attribution_service). Pass --serve to start the health API server.

market-tick-data-service.$note: Requires --mode. --dry-run prevents cloud writes in local dev.

instruments-service.$note: CLI requires --mode and --run-mode. aggregate+batch requires no dates (delta-only default).
